CveFindings.Name: Newtonsoft.Json: Improper handling of exceptional conditions (DoS via deeply nested JSON)
CveFindings.Description: Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi.Client 5.2.7 transitively resolves Newtonsoft.Json 6.0.4 (affected versions < 13.0.1, patched 13.0.1; GHSA-5crp-9r3c-p9vr). Add a direct PackageReference to Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.1 or later.
CveFindings.Explanation: Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi.Client 5.2.7 transitively resolves Newtonsoft.Json 6.0.4 (affected versions < 13.0.1, patched 13.0.1; GHSA-5crp-9r3c-p9vr). Add a direct PackageReference to Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.1 or later.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Obsolete Function
CweFindings.Explanation: Service targets .NET Framework 4.6.1 with legacy EntityFramework 6.1.3 and System.Data.SqlClient; WCF server APIs are not available on modern .NET.

CweFindings.Name: Data Access Operations Outside of Expected Data Manager Component
CweFindings.Description: Data access is performed directly from service operations rather than through a dedicated data manager component.
CweFindings.Explanation: CatalogService (WCF service layer) uses the EF DbContext directly and performs filtering client-side after ToList() (GetCatalogItems, GetDiscount, GetAvailableStock), loading entire tables into memory.

CweFindings.Name: Missing Synchronization
CweFindings.Explanation: CreateCatalogItem and CreateAvailableStock compute Max(Id)+1 and then insert without a transaction or lock, so concurrent requests can generate duplicate keys.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Password
CweFindings.Description: A hard-coded password is used for the SQL Server sa account.
CweFindings.Explanation: docker-compose.override.yml sets SA_PASSWORD and the sqlcmd healthcheck with the literal password 'Pass@word' and the service uses the 'sa' account.

CweFindings.Name: Insufficient Logging
CweFindings.Explanation: The service has no logging or auditing for create/update/remove catalog operations or failures.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CweFindings.Description: Hard-coded credentials are committed to configuration.
CweFindings.Explanation: Connection string and SQL sa credentials are stored in source control rather than a secret store.
